remarks: Drive down Lake Avenue and turn onto the private road of Rockview Drive to find this rare opportunity to acquire two spacious properties in the heart of Greenwich. Ideal for builders/investors seeking the opportunity to redevelop in a prime location, or for buyers looking to create a luxurious primary residence and/or a rental-income generating property. 35 Rockview was built circa 1904, showcasing architectural elegance with potential for restoration and modern improvements. The ''Carriage House'' #37 Rockview was built in 1999, offering a blend of rustic charm and modern amenities. A recent survey plan was completed for both properties, which now offers various options and possibilities depending on the buyer's vision. Schedule a tour to find out how to make this unique property yours! Please see Agent Remarks
